description: This Java source file defines the class 'DOMSettingsUnmarshaller' which is responsible for unmarshalling XML configuration data into a 'Settings' object. It includes methods to parse various nested elements such as window settings, file paths, options, table display options, logger configurations, colors, clipboard formats, and icons within an XML structure, primarily for configuring an application's UI and logging behavior.

classes.name: DOMSettingsUnmarshaller
classes.description: Main class for unmarshalling XML data into Settings object.

methods.name: unmarshallSettings
methods.description: Main method that unmarshalls the root XML node into a Settings object by processing its child nodes.

methods.name: unmarshallWindow
methods.description: Parses window-related settings from the XML node and updates the Settings object.

methods.name: unmarshallFiles
methods.description: Parses file path settings like ECU definitions, image directory, and repository directory.

methods.name: unmarshallOptions
methods.description: Parses application options such as warnings, debug mode, version info, display settings, etc.

methods.name: unmarshallTableDisplay
methods.description: Parses table display settings including font, cell size, and colors.

methods.name: unmarshallColors
methods.description: Parses color configurations such as max, min, highlight, and axis colors.

methods.name: unmarshallLogger
methods.description: Parses logger configuration including protocol, window size, location, plugins, and profiling settings.

methods.name: unmarshallColor
methods.description: Constructs a Color object from XML attributes r, g, b.

methods.name: unmarshallClipboardFormat
methods.description: Parses clipboard format settings for table data, including headers and format type.

methods.name: unmarshallIcons
methods.description: Parses icon scale settings for editor and table icons.
